name: AISiteVolt – AI Content, GEO, llms.txt & Local AI (Ollama)
author: emrahsnkli

sections.description:
AISiteVolt doesn’t just generate content — it repairs it. Most AI plugins only write new posts. AISiteVolt also fixes what you already have: it repairs old posts for Google, repairs your visibility for ChatGPT and Perplexity (GEO), and repairs thin product pages in your store. Everything runs with your own OpenAI API key — no monthly content fees, no data through our servers.

See it running — a real, unedited recording of the free plugin writing a post:

The free plugin includes everything you need to publish AI-assisted content:

  • Content Generator — Write SEO-friendly blog posts on any topic with GPT-4o
  • AI Image Generator — Create featured images with GPT Image
  • Content Repair — Scan existing posts and let AI fix grammar, SEO, readability, and outdated information
  • Quick AI Edit — Right-click any text in the editor to rewrite, summarize, expand, or translate it
  • AI Visibility (GEO) Analyzer — Score every post for AI-search citability (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini): direct-answer opening, FAQ, schema, structure — and see exactly what is missing
  • llms.txt Generator — One click creates the llms.txt file that introduces your site to AI crawlers
  • WooCommerce Content Scanner — Find products with thin descriptions, missing short descriptions and missing SEO meta
  • Image Alt Text Scanner — Find media library images that have no alt text (accessibility and image SEO)
  • Bulk Content — Turn a topic list into queued drafts, with SEO metadata written for each one (Pro adds CSV import with categories, authors, post types and scheduled publishing)
  • AI Visibility column — See every post’s GEO score right in the posts list
  • Accessibility scanner — Score posts and pages against WCAG / EAA for missing alt text, vague links, heading order and header-less tables (Pro repairs them with AI)
  • Local AI server support — Point the plugin at Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM or LiteLLM running on your own machine: no API bill, and not a single word leaves your server (setup guide)
  • Health Report — Generate an unlimited, printable website health report (GEO / AI-visibility scores plus accessibility findings) and save it as a PDF straight from your browser

Why people choose AISiteVolt:

  • You bring your own OpenAI API key — your data never passes through our servers
  • No external account required, no subscription needed for the free plugin
  • No monthly usage caps in the free plugin
  • Native WordPress UI — every tool sits inside your admin dashboard
  • GPLv2 licensed source

Works with your SEO plugin and WooCommerce

Generated meta descriptions and focus keywords are saved straight into Yoast SEO and Rank Math fields in the free plugin. The Professional upgrade also writes SEO titles and integrates with All in One SEO and The SEO Framework, plus rewrites WooCommerce product copy in bulk.

Upgrade to Pro — put content repair on autopilot

With Pro, AISiteVolt stops being a tool you use and becomes a system that works for you: Autopilot repairs your weakest posts on a schedule, the AI Visibility Fixer makes your articles quotable by ChatGPT and Perplexity, and the WooCommerce AI Writer rebuilds your whole catalog’s copy in bulk. Plus 15+ advanced modules and 7 more AI providers.

What’s inside Pro?

A paid Professional version is available at aisitevolt.com. It is delivered as an upgrade through Freemius and replaces this free plugin (same slug, no double-installation). The Professional upgrade adds entirely new modules and additional providers — none of those features run in the free plugin you just installed:

  • YouTube to Blog (transcript-to-article)
  • Audio to Blog (podcast / recording transcription)
  • AI Comment Replier
  • AI Internal Linker
  • AI Notebook (Google Docs / URL importer)
  • Reddit Research
  • Multi-Source Generator
  • Workflow Studio
  • SEO Analyzer
  • AI Chatbot for visitors, grounded in your Knowledge Base, with lead capture, “talk to a human” support tickets, live agent takeover (reply in real time from your dashboard) and an optional “Continue on WhatsApp” hand-off button
  • Accessibility Repair AI — one-click and autopilot WCAG / EAA fixes for alt text, link text, heading order and table headers
  • Lead Management
  • Automations — schedule AI work: create posts from topic lists, RSS feeds or page URLs; refresh old content; fully automatic internal linking; comment replies — all through a monitored queue with pause, retry and per-tick cost caps
  • AI Forms — no-code AI tools for your visitors (estimators, support helpers, brief generators) with an AI form designer, template gallery, lead capture and abuse protection
  • Monthly usage limits — site-wide and per-role AI spend/token caps with a clear block message
  • Event webhooks — Zapier/Make/n8n-compatible JSON events (content generated, form submitted, automation item completed)
  • Brand Monitor
  • AI Visibility Fixer & Autopilot (auto-repairs weak posts on a schedule: direct answers, FAQ sections, FAQ schema)
  • AI Citation Check (asks an AI assistant your post’s question and reports whether your site gets cited)
  • Weekly AI Visibility email report (site average, weakest posts, autopilot activity)
  • WooCommerce AI Writer (product descriptions, short descriptions, tags and SEO meta, grounded in real product data: SKU, stock, dimensions, attributes)
  • Unlimited Bulk Content batches + CSV import (categories, authors, post types, scheduled publishing)
  • Repair All queue for WooCommerce products and AI-written image alt text for your whole media library
  • White-label reports — put your agency name, logo and colors on the Health Report before sending it to clients
  • EAA accessibility deep-dive report — findings mapped to WCAG 2.1 criteria with a plain-language remediation plan
  • GEO trend — a daily snapshot of your site-wide AI-visibility score with a chart that proves the work is paying off
  • Catalog autopilot — rewrites thin WooCommerce product copy on a daily or weekly schedule, hands-free
  • AI Product Advisor — a storefront widget where visitors describe what they need and your AI recommends matching products
  • Settings export/import — move the plugin’s configuration between sites in one click (API keys are never exported)
  • Knowledge Base semantic grounding — mark posts as AI reference sources and bulk-index them so the chatbot and content tools answer from your own content
  • Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, OpenRouter (hundreds of models), DeepSeek, Stability AI, Replicate, Leonardo AI

The free plugin already works with every OpenAI model (GPT-5.5, GPT-5.4, GPT-4o, GPT Image 2, and more) using your own OpenAI API key — OpenAI models are never restricted in the free version.

Learn more:

  • Website: https://aisitevolt.com
  • Documentation: https://doc.aisitevolt.com
  • Privacy Policy: https://aisitevolt.com/privacy
  • Terms of Service: https://aisitevolt.com/terms
  • Support: support@aisitevolt.com

Privacy Policy

AISiteVolt does not collect, transmit, or store any personal data on AISiteVolt servers. All content you generate, edit, or import stays on your WordPress site.

When you trigger an AI action, the plugin sends your prompt directly to OpenAI using the API key you supplied. OpenAI’s privacy policy applies to those calls (see External Services below).

API keys are stored in your WordPress database and never leave your server.

Full privacy policy: https://aisitevolt.com/privacy

Terms of Service

AISiteVolt is released under GPLv2. You may use, modify, and redistribute freely.

You connect to OpenAI using your own API key. You are solely responsible for complying with OpenAI’s terms and any API costs.

The plugin is provided “as is” without warranty. AI output is probabilistic — always review before publishing.

Full terms: https://aisitevolt.com/terms

External Services

Optional: your own local AI server. If you fill in the “Local AI server” setting, requests go to the address you entered (for example http://localhost:11434 for Ollama) instead of to any third party. AISiteVolt does not choose that address and sends nothing there until you generate something. If you point it at a remote service, your prompts are sent to whoever runs that address.

The free plugin connects to two third-party services: OpenAI (for AI generation, using your own API key) and Freemius (licensing/upgrade infrastructure, detailed below). No data is sent to any service without an explicit user action (clicking generate, repair, edit, etc.), and no data ever passes through AISiteVolt servers.

OpenAI API (https://api.openai.com/)

  • Used for: Text generation (GPT-4o), image generation (GPT Image 1) and text-to-speech audio.
  • Endpoints used: https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions (text), https://api.openai.com/v1/images/generations (images), https://api.openai.com/v1/images/edits (only when you supply a reference image in the Image Generator), https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/speech (only when you enable “Convert to audio” in Content Repair — the post title and content are sent to generate the narration) and https://api.openai.com/v1/models (only when you click “Test Connection” in Settings, to verify your API key).
  • Data sent: The prompts and content you supply when you click Generate, Repair, or Edit; the post title and content when you enable “Convert to audio”; plus the reference image you upload, if you use one. The Test Connection call sends only your API key.
  • When: Only when a user explicitly triggers a generation, repair, edit, audio-conversion or connection-test action.
  • Note: when you give Content Repair or Page Repair a source URL, your server also fetches that page (the URL you typed) to read its content — no other data is sent anywhere in that step.
  • This service is provided by OpenAI, Inc.
  • Privacy Policy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy
  • Terms of Use: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use

Freemius (https://freemius.com/ — endpoints: wp.freemius.com, api.freemius.com, checkout.freemius.com)

  • Used for: The upgrade path to the separate Professional plugin — opt-in usage diagnostics, license/update checks for paying customers, and the secure checkout page. The plugin bundles the Freemius SDK for this.
  • Data sent: Nothing is sent unless you either opt in on the activation screen or start a checkout. If you opt in, Freemius receives your site URL, WordPress/PHP/plugin version and admin email address to provide update and support services. If you skip opt-in, the free plugin works fully and sends no data to Freemius. Your content and API keys are never sent to Freemius.
  • When: On explicit opt-in after activation, on checkout, and (for opted-in or paying users) periodic license/update checks.
  • This service is provided by Freemius, Inc.
  • Privacy Policy: https://freemius.com/privacy/
  • Terms of Use: https://freemius.com/terms/

In the separate AISiteVolt Professional plugin, the AI Chatbot is the one feature where a site visitor — rather than an administrator — triggers a call to your AI provider: when a visitor sends a chat message, that message, the recent messages of the same conversation and the Knowledge Base entries you wrote are sent to the provider using your own API key. The chatbot is off until you enable it, it is absent from the free plugin, and it never sends anything to AISiteVolt servers.

The separate AISiteVolt Professional plugin (sold at aisitevolt.com, not distributed here) adds further AI providers — Anthropic, Google Gemini, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Stability AI, Replicate, Leonardo AI — plus optional Reddit, YouTube and stock-photo lookups. The free plugin on WordPress.org contains no code that connects to any of them. Each is documented, with the data sent and the provider’s terms, at https://doc.aisitevolt.com/reference/external-services.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/auto-repai-ai-content-generator/, or install through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins screen.
  3. Open AISiteVolt > Settings and paste your OpenAI API key.
  4. Visit AISiteVolt > Content Generator and create your first AI post.

Full getting-started guide: https://doc.aisitevolt.com
sections.faq:
Does it work with Yoast SEO or Rank Math?

Yes. When you generate content with SEO metadata enabled, the meta description and focus keyword are written directly into Yoast SEO and Rank Math fields (when those plugins are active). AISiteVolt Pro additionally writes SEO titles and supports All in One SEO and The SEO Framework.

Do I need an OpenAI account?

Yes. AISiteVolt calls OpenAI directly using your own API key. You will need an OpenAI account and API credit. The plugin itself is free.

Is the free plugin really unrestricted?

Yes. There are no monthly usage caps. Use it as much as your OpenAI account allows.

Which AI model does the free plugin use?

GPT-4o for text and GPT Image 1 for images. The Professional upgrade (sold from aisitevolt.com) adds the latest OpenAI models (GPT-5.5, GPT Image 2) and additional providers.

How do I upgrade to Professional?

Click AISiteVolt → Pro Features in your WordPress admin, then click Get AISiteVolt Professional. You will be redirected to a secure Freemius checkout. After payment you receive a download link for the Professional version, which replaces the free plugin in place.

Where is my data stored?

Everything stays on your WordPress site. AISiteVolt does not have a cloud or proxy — your prompts go directly from your server to OpenAI.

Where can I get support?

Free users: the WordPress.org support forum. Professional users: priority email at support@aisitevolt.com.

Is the source code open?

Yes, GPLv2. The full source ships with the plugin and can be inspected in your wp-content/plugins/auto-repai-ai-content-generator/ directory after installation.

  • The plugin is now called AISiteVolt. Only the name and the branding changed — the same plugin, the same settings, the same license. Nothing needs to be reconfigured and no content is affected.
  • The “Auto Repair” screen is now called “Content Repair”. It does exactly what it did before; the old name suggested car repair to too many people.
  • The website moved to aisitevolt.com and the documentation to doc.aisitevolt.com. Old links redirect.

2.11.4

  • Listing only: the short description and tags now name the things this plugin is actually searched for — running locally with Ollama, llms txt, GEO, WCAG. No code changes.

2.11.3

  • Fixed: on a fresh install the plugin was unusable until the opt-in screen was answered — no submenus were registered and every plugin page returned 403, so even Settings could not be opened. The opt-in prompt is still shown, but it no longer blocks the plugin.

2.11.2

  • Listing only: the plugin name and tags now say what the plugin actually does (GEO, llms.txt, local AI) so it can be found by those searches. No code changes.

2.11.1

  • Fixed: Save Settings could silently do nothing. A number field on a hidden tab (max tokens) rejected any value that was not a multiple of 100, which blocked the whole form without showing an error. Values are now accepted as typed.
  • Improved: if a settings field really is invalid, the plugin now opens the tab it lives on and shows the message instead of failing quietly.

  • Note: the local server is used for text. Image generation, transcription and speech still go through the provider that supports them.

  • New (Pro): EAA accessibility deep-dive report template — automated findings mapped to WCAG 2.1 success criteria with per-page details and a remediation plan.

  • Improved: internal links applied manually or by Automations are recorded in a new “Applied links archive”.

2.9.0

Add an “image” field and visitors can upload a JPG/PNG/WEBP that a vision-capable model (OpenAI) actually looks at — build image-analysis tools, visual Q&A and more. A “file” field accepts a .txt whose text is fed into the prompt. A new “Image analysis” template is included.

  • Fixed image sizes: GPT Image models only support 1024×1024, 1536×1024, 1024×1536, and auto. Removed the old DALL-E sizes (512×512, 1024×1792, 1792×1024) that caused “invalid size” errors; the provider also normalizes any unsupported size.

1.7.1

  • Image Generator settings cleaned up: “Number of Images” moved to the top with clear labels, lighter native-style controls.

1.7.0

  • Professional: Knowledge Base — add your own reference material (product facts, brand voice, past articles); the most relevant entries are fed to the AI so content is grounded in YOUR data, not generic output.
  • Professional: Compare image providers — generate the same prompt with OpenAI, Gemini, Stability, and Flux at once and pick the best.

1.6.0

  • Professional: Compare Across Models — generate the same topic with OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, and DeepSeek at once, then publish whichever result you prefer.

1.5.0

  • Content Generator now produces SEO metadata (meta description, focus keyword, tags) alongside the article, applied to the post and to Yoast / Rank Math on creation.
  • Added Content Length control (Short/Medium/Long/Comprehensive word-count targets) and an inline SEO toggle.
  • Expanded Settings > Defaults: content length, auto-SEO, default featured image, images per generation, and default image style.

1.4.3

  • Updated OpenAI models: DALL-E 2/3 were removed from the OpenAI API (May 2026), so image generation now uses GPT Image 1 by default (with automatic fallback). Free plan uses GPT-4o + GPT Image 1; the Professional version adds the latest OpenAI models (GPT-5.5 family, GPT Image 2/1.5).
  • Reference-image generation now uses the GPT Image edit endpoint (DALL-E 2 variations were retired).

1.4.2

  • Featured image generation now works on OpenAI accounts that do not have DALL-E 3: it uses gpt-image-1 by default and automatically falls back between gpt-image-1 and dall-e-3 depending on which your account can access.

1.4.1

  • When “Generate Featured Image” is enabled but the image cannot be created (e.g. the OpenAI account has no image credits), the exact reason is now shown inline with the generated content instead of silently producing no image.

1.4.0

  • Fixed the “Test Connection” button on the Settings page: it now actually verifies your API key against the provider (the AJAX handler was missing, so it always showed “Connection failed”).

1.3.9

1.3.8

New bulk options: Fix Content (grammar, readability, formatting, and duplicate-phrase removal while preserving HTML/shortcodes/images), Fix Image Alt Text (generates alt text for images missing it), and Fix Schema (adds Article JSON-LD structured data, output on the frontend).

Lead Management is retained and unaffected; its chat-log viewer now reads stored data directly without the chatbot module.

short_description: Write and repair WordPress content with AI. Run it locally with Ollama, or use your own OpenAI key. GEO scoring, llms txt, WCAG checks.
description:
AISiteVolt doesn’t just generate content — it repairs it. Most AI plugins only write new posts. AISiteVolt also fixes what you already have: it repairs old posts for Google, repairs your visibility for ChatGPT and Perplexity (GEO), and repairs thin product pages in your store. Everything runs with your own OpenAI API key — no monthly content fees, no data through our servers.

See it running — a real, unedited recording of the free plugin writing a post:

The free plugin includes everything you need to publish AI-assisted content:

  • Content Generator — Write SEO-friendly blog posts on any topic with GPT-4o
  • AI Image Generator — Create featured images with GPT Image
  • Content Repair — Scan existing posts and let AI fix grammar, SEO, readability, and outdated information
  • Quick AI Edit — Right-click any text in the editor to rewrite, summarize, expand, or translate it
  • AI Visibility (GEO) Analyzer — Score every post for AI-search citability (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini): direct-answer opening, FAQ, schema, structure — and see exactly what is missing
  • llms.txt Generator — One click creates the llms.txt file that introduces your site to AI crawlers
  • WooCommerce Content Scanner — Find products with thin descriptions, missing short descriptions and missing SEO meta
  • Image Alt Text Scanner — Find media library images that have no alt text (accessibility and image SEO)
  • Bulk Content — Turn a topic list into queued drafts, with SEO metadata written for each one (Pro adds CSV import with categories, authors, post types and scheduled publishing)
  • AI Visibility column — See every post’s GEO score right in the posts list
  • Accessibility scanner — Score posts and pages against WCAG / EAA for missing alt text, vague links, heading order and header-less tables (Pro repairs them with AI)
  • Local AI server support — Point the plugin at Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM or LiteLLM running on your own machine: no API bill, and not a single word leaves your server (setup guide)
  • Health Report — Generate an unlimited, printable website health report (GEO / AI-visibility scores plus accessibility findings) and save it as a PDF straight from your browser

Why people choose AISiteVolt:

  • You bring your own OpenAI API key — your data never passes through our servers
  • No external account required, no subscription needed for the free plugin
  • No monthly usage caps in the free plugin
  • Native WordPress UI — every tool sits inside your admin dashboard
  • GPLv2 licensed source

Works with your SEO plugin and WooCommerce

Generated meta descriptions and focus keywords are saved straight into Yoast SEO and Rank Math fields in the free plugin. The Professional upgrade also writes SEO titles and integrates with All in One SEO and The SEO Framework, plus rewrites WooCommerce product copy in bulk.

Upgrade to Pro — put content repair on autopilot

With Pro, AISiteVolt stops being a tool you use and becomes a system that works for you: Autopilot repairs your weakest posts on a schedule, the AI Visibility Fixer makes your articles quotable by ChatGPT and Perplexity, and the WooCommerce AI Writer rebuilds your whole catalog’s copy in bulk. Plus 15+ advanced modules and 7 more AI providers.

What’s inside Pro?

A paid Professional version is available at aisitevolt.com. It is delivered as an upgrade through Freemius and replaces this free plugin (same slug, no double-installation). The Professional upgrade adds entirely new modules and additional providers — none of those features run in the free plugin you just installed:

  • YouTube to Blog (transcript-to-article)
  • Audio to Blog (podcast / recording transcription)
  • AI Comment Replier
  • AI Internal Linker
  • AI Notebook (Google Docs / URL importer)
  • Reddit Research
  • Multi-Source Generator
  • Workflow Studio
  • SEO Analyzer
  • AI Chatbot for visitors, grounded in your Knowledge Base, with lead capture, “talk to a human” support tickets, live agent takeover (reply in real time from your dashboard) and an optional “Continue on WhatsApp” hand-off button
  • Accessibility Repair AI — one-click and autopilot WCAG / EAA fixes for alt text, link text, heading order and table headers
  • Lead Management
  • Automations — schedule AI work: create posts from topic lists, RSS feeds or page URLs; refresh old content; fully automatic internal linking; comment replies — all through a monitored queue with pause, retry and per-tick cost caps
  • AI Forms — no-code AI tools for your visitors (estimators, support helpers, brief generators) with an AI form designer, template gallery, lead capture and abuse protection
  • Monthly usage limits — site-wide and per-role AI spend/token caps with a clear block message
  • Event webhooks — Zapier/Make/n8n-compatible JSON events (content generated, form submitted, automation item completed)
  • Brand Monitor
  • AI Visibility Fixer & Autopilot (auto-repairs weak posts on a schedule: direct answers, FAQ sections, FAQ schema)
  • AI Citation Check (asks an AI assistant your post’s question and reports whether your site gets cited)
  • Weekly AI Visibility email report (site average, weakest posts, autopilot activity)
  • WooCommerce AI Writer (product descriptions, short descriptions, tags and SEO meta, grounded in real product data: SKU, stock, dimensions, attributes)
  • Unlimited Bulk Content batches + CSV import (categories, authors, post types, scheduled publishing)
  • Repair All queue for WooCommerce products and AI-written image alt text for your whole media library
  • White-label reports — put your agency name, logo and colors on the Health Report before sending it to clients
  • EAA accessibility deep-dive report — findings mapped to WCAG 2.1 criteria with a plain-language remediation plan
  • GEO trend — a daily snapshot of your site-wide AI-visibility score with a chart that proves the work is paying off
  • Catalog autopilot — rewrites thin WooCommerce product copy on a daily or weekly schedule, hands-free
  • AI Product Advisor — a storefront widget where visitors describe what they need and your AI recommends matching products
  • Settings export/import — move the plugin’s configuration between sites in one click (API keys are never exported)
  • Knowledge Base semantic grounding — mark posts as AI reference sources and bulk-index them so the chatbot and content tools answer from your own content
  • Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, OpenRouter (hundreds of models), DeepSeek, Stability AI, Replicate, Leonardo AI

The free plugin already works with every OpenAI model (GPT-5.5, GPT-5.4, GPT-4o, GPT Image 2, and more) using your own OpenAI API key — OpenAI models are never restricted in the free version.

Learn more:

  • Website: https://aisitevolt.com
  • Documentation: https://doc.aisitevolt.com
  • Privacy Policy: https://aisitevolt.com/privacy
  • Terms of Service: https://aisitevolt.com/terms
  • Support: support@aisitevolt.com

Privacy Policy

AISiteVolt does not collect, transmit, or store any personal data on AISiteVolt servers. All content you generate, edit, or import stays on your WordPress site.

When you trigger an AI action, the plugin sends your prompt directly to OpenAI using the API key you supplied. OpenAI’s privacy policy applies to those calls (see External Services below).

API keys are stored in your WordPress database and never leave your server.

Full privacy policy: https://aisitevolt.com/privacy

Terms of Service

AISiteVolt is released under GPLv2. You may use, modify, and redistribute freely.

You connect to OpenAI using your own API key. You are solely responsible for complying with OpenAI’s terms and any API costs.

The plugin is provided “as is” without warranty. AI output is probabilistic — always review before publishing.

Full terms: https://aisitevolt.com/terms

External Services

Optional: your own local AI server. If you fill in the “Local AI server” setting, requests go to the address you entered (for example http://localhost:11434 for Ollama) instead of to any third party. AISiteVolt does not choose that address and sends nothing there until you generate something. If you point it at a remote service, your prompts are sent to whoever runs that address.

The free plugin connects to two third-party services: OpenAI (for AI generation, using your own API key) and Freemius (licensing/upgrade infrastructure, detailed below). No data is sent to any service without an explicit user action (clicking generate, repair, edit, etc.), and no data ever passes through AISiteVolt servers.

OpenAI API (https://api.openai.com/)

  • Used for: Text generation (GPT-4o), image generation (GPT Image 1) and text-to-speech audio.
  • Endpoints used: https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions (text), https://api.openai.com/v1/images/generations (images), https://api.openai.com/v1/images/edits (only when you supply a reference image in the Image Generator), https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/speech (only when you enable “Convert to audio” in Content Repair — the post title and content are sent to generate the narration) and https://api.openai.com/v1/models (only when you click “Test Connection” in Settings, to verify your API key).
  • Data sent: The prompts and content you supply when you click Generate, Repair, or Edit; the post title and content when you enable “Convert to audio”; plus the reference image you upload, if you use one. The Test Connection call sends only your API key.
  • When: Only when a user explicitly triggers a generation, repair, edit, audio-conversion or connection-test action.
  • Note: when you give Content Repair or Page Repair a source URL, your server also fetches that page (the URL you typed) to read its content — no other data is sent anywhere in that step.
  • This service is provided by OpenAI, Inc.
  • Privacy Policy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy
  • Terms of Use: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use

Freemius (https://freemius.com/ — endpoints: wp.freemius.com, api.freemius.com, checkout.freemius.com)

  • Used for: The upgrade path to the separate Professional plugin — opt-in usage diagnostics, license/update checks for paying customers, and the secure checkout page. The plugin bundles the Freemius SDK for this.
  • Data sent: Nothing is sent unless you either opt in on the activation screen or start a checkout. If you opt in, Freemius receives your site URL, WordPress/PHP/plugin version and admin email address to provide update and support services. If you skip opt-in, the free plugin works fully and sends no data to Freemius. Your content and API keys are never sent to Freemius.
  • When: On explicit opt-in after activation, on checkout, and (for opted-in or paying users) periodic license/update checks.
  • This service is provided by Freemius, Inc.
  • Privacy Policy: https://freemius.com/privacy/
  • Terms of Use: https://freemius.com/terms/

In the separate AISiteVolt Professional plugin, the AI Chatbot is the one feature where a site visitor — rather than an administrator — triggers a call to your AI provider: when a visitor sends a chat message, that message, the recent messages of the same conversation and the Knowledge Base entries you wrote are sent to the provider using your own API key. The chatbot is off until you enable it, it is absent from the free plugin, and it never sends anything to AISiteVolt servers.

The separate AISiteVolt Professional plugin (sold at aisitevolt.com, not distributed here) adds further AI providers — Anthropic, Google Gemini, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Stability AI, Replicate, Leonardo AI — plus optional Reddit, YouTube and stock-photo lookups. The free plugin on WordPress.org contains no code that connects to any of them. Each is documented, with the data sent and the provider’s terms, at https://doc.aisitevolt.com/reference/external-services.
